_comment: HOW MUCH A PIVOT ARTIFACT IS WORTH. These tables carry analyst JUDGMENT, not facts: the confidence WebPivot stamps on a SaaS-token pivot, and which URL params count as affiliate attribution. Edit them when tradecraft changes — e.g. a SaaS starts sharing a tenant id across customers (drop it to null) or a new affiliate network appears.

saas_pivots._comment: SaaS/automation token kind -> [confidence, analyst note]. confidence is 'high' when the token identifies an OPERATOR-CONTROLLED account (a GoHighLevel sub-account, a backend Google Sheet, a Zapier hook) so a shared value means a shared operator. Use null for a token that only signals a funnel TYPE and must not drive clustering. The note is printed next to the pivot, so write it for the analyst who has to act on it.

gohighlevel_location: GoHighLevel sub-account (location) ID. Same GHL tenant = same operator; find its whole portfolio.
google_sheet: Backend Google Sheet ID embedded in the page. Same sheet = same operator — and it may be publicly readable (check for exposed leads/PII).
google_doc: Backend Google Doc ID embedded in the page. Same doc = same operator — and it may be publicly readable.
google_slides: Backend Google Slides ID embedded in the page. Same deck = same operator.
google_form: Google Form the page collects leads with — operator-controlled. Same form = same operator (responses may be readable).
google_drive: Google Drive folder/file ID referenced by the page — operator asset store. Same ID = same operator.
make_webhook: Make.com automation webhook — operator-controlled endpoint. Same token = same operator.
integromat_webhook: Integromat/Make automation webhook — operator-controlled. Same token = same operator.
zapier_webhook: Zapier catch hook — operator-controlled automation endpoint. Same token = same operator.
apps_script: Google Apps Script web-app the form posts to — operator-controlled. Same deployment = same operator.
trustedform: TrustedForm (TCPA lead certification) — signals a lead-generation funnel; not an operator pivot.

affiliate_params._comment: Query-parameter NAMES that carry affiliate / referral / campaign attribution. When a redirector's destination stamps one of these, the VALUE is the real pivot — source-search it to find everywhere that promoter advertises. Matched lowercase, exact.
